text:
Kira: proposal  lean Optimize MVP for next sprint: ship eval-triggered alerts (minimal payload + dry-run) + deterministic quantization advice (INT8/FP16 rules). Defer adaptive batching and cache eviction heuristics. ok? :seedling:

Ethan: +1. Keep API surface tiny. Req: clear firing semantics, a dry_run mode, and per-org feature-flag. Also prefer alert payload limited to top 5 failing ids to start.

Vik: SRE asks: define event schema, default retention, and a small throttle/dedupe. Propose retention 90d for raw alerts, 365d for aggregates. Dedupe default 15m and circuit-breaker if org >300 alerts/day.

Gabi: CS note  NovoMed happy to canary if we provide preview (dry_run=true) and a CS webhook for each alert. They want per-model thresholds.

Kira: draft ACs (please comment):
1) Emission: alerts produced within 60s of eval-run completion for orgs with flag enabled.
2) Config: per-org/per-model thresholds via API/Console.
3) Payload: model_id, model_version, eval_run_id, metric_deltas, top_5 failing_example_ids, link to eval report.
4) Noise control: dedupe window (default 15m), per-org rate cap (default 4/hr), circuit-breaker >300/day.
5) Retention: raw alert events 90d, aggregates 365d.
6) Dry-run: record alerts but do not notify external customers; CS webhook still receives preview.
7) Canary: feature-flag gated, NovoMed opt-in.

Ethan: quant rules (MVP) suggestion: rule-based recommender outputting advisory suggestions only. Example rules:
- Recommend INT8 if p99 latency improves >=12% and eval-concordance drop <=1%.
- Recommend FP16 if latency improves >=6% and concordance drop <=0.5% (lower risk).
Recommendation fields: rec_type, expected_p99_delta_pct, expected_throughput_pct, token_cost_estimate, short_risk_note.

Vik: also need an "ops_summary" index for quick triage and a small rollback playbook if alerts flood. I'll draft schema PR.

Gabi: I'll confirm NovoMed and schedule CS pre-notify. They want a CLI example to enable canary.

Kira: CLI example for feature flag (canary):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/feature-flags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"optimize_eval_preview","enabled":true,"targets":[{"org":"novomed"}],"dry_run":true}'
```
ops-bot: feature flag created: optimize_eval_preview (id: ff-8310) :white_check_mark:

Ethan: I'll scope minimal API endpoints + Console preview card and wire in dedupe and retention hooks. Target E2E for canary in 2 sprints.

Kira: plan of record: ship eval-triggered alerts (preview + opt-in canary) + deterministic quant recs (INT8/FP16 advisory). Move batching/cache heuristics to Backlog. PM will add tickets and ACs. Thanks! :v:
